# stalwart Provider

Manages configuration of a Stalwart mail and collaboration server through its JMAP management API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    stalwart = {
      source  = "tahacodes/stalwart"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "stalwart" {
  endpoint = "https://mail.example.com"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.stalwart_admin_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Stalwart server, for example `https://mail.example.com`. Falls back to the `STALWART_URL` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to `false`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for basic authentication. Falls back to the `STALWART_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token, mutually exclusive with `username` and `password`. Falls back to the `STALWART_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for basic authentication. Falls back to the `STALWART_USER` environment variable.
